title: Going to Europe with Archey, December 1952
summary: After about three years at Ryan's, Waters sailed with Archey's band for a month's European tour just before Christmas, thinking of Paris.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: You say you were at Ryan's with Archey from '49 to '52, '50 to '52 -
And went, we went - I left, I went to Europe with Jimmy Archey.
Yeah, and I went there in 1950, the end of 1950, the end of December.
And I remember because just before Christmas.
Just before Christmas 1952, you went as a member of Archey's band for a European tour.
